name: Shenzhen Kinwong Electronic Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Kinwong Electronic Co., Ltd. researches, develops, produces and sells printed circuit boards and electronic materials in China and internationally. Its range includes single-, double- and multi-layer boards, metal-based boards using copper, aluminium, stainless steel or iron, flexible boards, and high density interconnect, RF microwave and rigid-flex boards.
